pair.baseline: Tracked linked blocker claim after take-up.
pair.mutation: Retitle the tracked blocker before close.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a tracked title change require a close-time scope hold?

replay.test: a real scope edit between take-up and close still holds on claim:scope

pair.baseline: Tracked Jira claim with its original description fingerprint.
pair.mutation: Change the description after the baseline.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a description revision require a scope hold at selection?

replay.test: stays CURRENT for marker-only movement and holds on changed scope

pair.baseline: Jira item after native SELECT and a committed claim with its original label set.
pair.mutation: Add a label while retaining the original summary, description and workflow state.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does labels-only movement participate in the BEFORE_PR scope comparison?

replay.test: native replay: labels-only mutation after SELECT and a tracked claim holds claim:scope at BEFORE_PR

pair.baseline: Tracked linked blocker set after take-up.
pair.mutation: Add a new blocker link before close.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a new blocker link require a close-time scope hold?

replay.test: a real link edit (a new blocker added) between take-up and close still holds on claim:scope

pair.baseline: Tracked claim before the declared in-progress transition.
pair.mutation: Move the item to the expected claimed state outside the adapter.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does an externally performed workflow transition require a scope hold?

replay.test: holds claim:scope when an external actor moves the item to the expected claimed state

pair.baseline: Tracked claim with paired-alpha.txt content fingerprinted.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a tracked paired-fact change require a scope hold?

pair.baseline: Tracked claim with one known commentary identity.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does SELECT intentionally defer commentary comparison under the current policy?

replay.test: defers an added comment through SELECT and BEFORE_PR, then holds at BEFORE_CLOSE

pair.baseline: Tracked claimed item with known commentary identities.
pair.mutation: Add commentary before the pull-request checkpoint.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does BEFORE_PR intentionally defer commentary comparison under the current policy?

replay.test: defers an added comment through SELECT and BEFORE_PR, then holds at BEFORE_CLOSE

pair.baseline: Tracked claimed item with known commentary identities.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does BEFORE_CLOSE hold on changed commentary identities without copying bodies?

replay.test: defers an added comment through SELECT and BEFORE_PR, then holds at BEFORE_CLOSE

pair.baseline: Feature checkout and target share the recorded target baseline.
pair.mutation: Land one genuine up-to-date squash merge and name its exact merge commit.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does the verified one-commit own squash advance continue at close?

replay.test: the item's own REAL squash merge (actual file content, not an empty commit), nothing foreign, correctly named by --merge-commit

pair.baseline: Feature checkout and target share the recorded target baseline.
pair.mutation: Land the target advance but omit --merge-commit evidence.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a target advance without merge provenance hold at close?

replay.test: no --merge-commit supplied at all, even though the target moved by exactly one commit that would otherwise exempt it

pair.baseline: Recorded target baseline and feature tree.
pair.mutation: Supply a fabricated merge commit whose tree matches the feature but never advanced the target.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does fabricated merge evidence remain a scope hold?

replay.test: a FABRICATED --merge-commit sharing HEAD's tree, correctly rooted at the baseline, but naming a commit the target never actually advanced to, still holds

pair.baseline: Recorded target baseline and feature tree.
pair.mutation: Name a single foreign target commit as the merge evidence.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a foreign named advance remain a scope hold?

replay.test: a single FOREIGN commit named as --merge-commit does not exempt it

pair.baseline: Recorded target baseline and up-to-date feature checkout.
pair.mutation: Land a foreign empty target commit before the genuine squash merge.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does an otherwise invisible concurrent target advance remain a scope hold?

replay.test: a foreign EMPTY commit ahead of the genuine squash still holds

pair.baseline: Tracked claim is a regular validated file.
pair.mutation: Replace the tracked claim path with a symlink.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does claim-path indirection fail closed as unverifiable?

replay.test: refuses a tracked claim symlink instead of following it

pair.baseline: Adapter returns a complete commentary window with a declared total.
pair.mutation: Return fewer commentary identities than the declared total.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does incomplete adapter evidence fail closed as unverifiable?

replay.test: refuses SELECT when comment.total exceeds the returned comment ids

pair.baseline: Tracked claim before a scope drift detection.
pair.mutation: Create a CHANGED detection and record a typed action-changing outcome through the command.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does the native outcome command preserve a typed resolution for a caught detection?

replay.test: native replay: records action-changing true for a real CHANGED detection through the outcome command

pair.baseline: A recorded CHANGED detection with no valid resolution.
pair.mutation: Leave the outcome missing or malformed.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does a catch remain unresolved without a boolean outcome verdict?

replay.test: native replay: retains a real CHANGED detection without an outcome as unresolved

pair.baseline: Tracked claim whose fingerprints match the current item.
pair.mutation: Move only the observation marker without changing the fingerprinted body.

controls.checkpointQuestion: Does marker-only movement remain current rather than create a scope hold?

replay.test: stays CURRENT for marker-only movement and holds on changed scope
